narr: Heavy rain fell across portions of Robertson and Sumner counties during the early morning hours of June 30, 2024. Official measurements showed 3 to 3.5 inches of rain in a short period of time, and the White House area was hardest hit by flooding with numerous homes reported flooded.
ev: Heavy rain fell across portions of Sumner County during the early morning hours of June 30th. CoCoRaHS observers in this area measured 3 to 3.5 inches of rain which caused flooding. The White House area was hardest hit with flooding. In White House, roads that were flooded included Highway 31, Rolling Acres Drive, Union Road, Winchester Court, and Autumn Wood Drive. Along Autumn Wood Drive, one home was flooded, and a car was overturned. Homes were also flooded on Winchester Court and Rolling Acres Drive. Damages are a rough estimate.

Heavy rain fell across portions of Robertson County during the early morning hours of June 30th with flooding reported in the Cross Plains area. CoCoRaHS observers in this area measured 3 to 3.5 inches of rain. In Cross Plains, flooding was reported along Owens Chapel Road at Cross Plains Road. Damages are a rough estimate.
